content: Yolin qMan Dios noq tuꞌn Tkꞌwal
Toj ilaꞌx maj, yolin Dios ojtxe kye qxeꞌchil, ex kyukꞌa ilaꞌ wiq tumil, yolin noq kyuꞌn xjal, ayeꞌ yolil Tyol.

Me atzin jaꞌlin, nyolin qMan Dios qe, noq tuꞌn Jesús, a Tkꞌwal; quꞌn tuꞌn a Dios bꞌinchilte tkyaqil twutz txꞌotxꞌ ex tkyaqil twutz kyaꞌj, noq tuꞌn Tkꞌwal. Ikytziꞌn tzeꞌnku jun kꞌwal at toklin tiꞌj tkyaqiljo a at te ttata, exsin ikyxjo te Jesús at toklin tiꞌj tkyaqiljo a at te ttata, a qMan Dios.

Nyekꞌin Jesús tqoptzꞌajiyil tipin Dios, ikyxjo tzeꞌnku tqan qꞌij nyekꞌin tipin tqoptzꞌajiyil qꞌij; ex ate Jesús, tyekꞌbꞌil qMan Dios, a nya qꞌanchaꞌl. Ex ate Jesús Nukꞌil ex Xqꞌuqil tibꞌaj tkyaqil, noq tuꞌn Tyol nimxix tipin. Tej ttxjet tkyaqil qil tuꞌn, o kubꞌ qe toj kyaꞌj, kawil junx tukꞌa qMan Dios.
Atzin Tkꞌwal Dios nimxixtl toklin tzeꞌn kye angel
Tuꞌntzin tkyaqiljo luꞌn, ate Jesús o tzꞌok nimxixtl toklin tzeꞌnku tkyaqil angel, quꞌn tuꞌn kꞌwalbꞌaj te qMan Dios. Qalaqetziꞌn kye angel, at kyoklin, me noq te taqꞌnil.

Quꞌn mix jaꞌ xi tqꞌmaꞌn te Dios te jun angel, tzeꞌnku xi tqꞌmaꞌn te Jesús kyjaluꞌn: Ma tzꞌoka te nkꞌwala jaꞌlin. Ex ntiꞌ xi tqꞌmaꞌn te jun angel: Ayiꞌn weꞌ manbꞌaj tey, ex a te kꞌwalbꞌaj wey, tzeꞌnku xi tqꞌmaꞌn te Jesús.
Ex tej titzꞌje Jesús tzaluꞌn twutz txꞌotxꞌ, tqꞌma Dios kyjaluꞌn: Il tiꞌj tuꞌn kykꞌulin angel twutz.
Ex toj Tuꞌjil Tyol Dios, chitzin Diosjo kyiꞌj angel kyjaluꞌn:

content.text: O chi kubꞌ tbꞌinchin Dios angel, tuꞌn kyok te tsan,
ex tzunxix nchi ajqelin wen tuꞌn kyajbꞌinxix te,

content: Me mikyxi yoline Diosjo tukꞌa Tkꞌwal, qalaꞌ chitzin kyjaluꞌn toj Tuꞌjil Tyol Dios:

content.text: Ay Dios, a tAjaw Tkyaqil, atzin Tkawbꞌila nimxix toklin te jun majx, ex tzꞌaqlexix wen.
ex o tzꞌel tikyꞌinjiy a nya toj tumil.
Tuꞌntziꞌn ikyjo, o tzꞌok qꞌoꞌn te Kawil tuꞌn qMan Dios, a tDiosa,
ex nimxixtl ntzalaj tiꞌja tzeꞌnku kye angel, ayeꞌ iteꞌ tukꞌiy.

content: Ex ikyxjo yolin Tyol Dios tiꞌjjo Tkꞌwal kyjaluꞌn:

content.text: Ay, tAjaw Tkyaqil, te tnejil o kubꞌ tbꞌinchiꞌn jniꞌ txꞌotxꞌ ex tkyaqil kyaꞌj.
Me atzin txꞌotxꞌ exqetziꞌn kyaꞌj, ok kchi bꞌajil, ex kchi xel xoyit, ex kchi ttxꞌaqinixil tzeꞌnku jun xbꞌalin.
Qalatziꞌn te, ok ktenbꞌil te, te jun majx.

content: Ex bꞌajxe tqꞌmaye qMan Dios te jun angel kyjaluꞌn:

content.text: Qekuy nkꞌatza tuꞌn tkawiꞌn junx wukꞌiy, tzmaxi aj kykanbꞌit tajqꞌoja wuꞌn.

content: Qalaqetziꞌn kye angel, xewbꞌajqe; ex nchi ajbꞌin te tsan Dios, ex smaꞌnqe tuꞌn Dios tuꞌn kymojitjo xjal, ayeꞌ kchi kletil tuꞌn.
